name: Sega NAOMI 2
description: The 2000 successor to NAOMI, adding a hardware transform-and-lighting coprocessor and a second PowerVR graphics chip. It ran Virtua Fighter 4 and the Initial D Arcade Stage series and remains backward compatible with NAOMI games.

specs.media: ROM boards; GD-ROM via DIMM board

curiosities: Its Elan chip moved geometry transform and lighting off the CPU, a feature the original NAOMI lacked.
Virtua Fighter 4 debuted on NAOMI 2 in 2001 before its PlayStation 2 port.
Initial D Arcade Stage (2002) ran on the board and spawned a long-running arcade series.
Its board carries two PowerVR2 graphics chips, against one on the original NAOMI.
